title: Reject late Provider completion after cancellation
goal: Ensure non-stream HTTP chat completion cannot return success if its transport returns a response after the calling task was cancelled.
context: HTTPChatProvider.complete checks cancellation before sending, but does not recheck after awaiting sendWithRetry. A non-cooperative transport can return a successful HTTP response after cancellation and have it decoded as a successful completion.
forbidden_changes: Do not change retry classification or timeout semantics.
Do not mask provider errors as successful completions.
Do not modify App/ or Xcode project files.
Do not weaken streaming cancellation behavior.
acceptance_criteria: complete rechecks cancellation after the transport await and maps it to ProviderRuntimeError.cancelled.
A deterministic regression transport signals request start, ignores cancellation during a wait, then returns HTTP 200.
The regression test proves the late success is rejected as cancelled.
verification: Confirm Swift package tests + repository integrity, macOS Xcode iOS arm64 build/unsigned IPA, and validate-contract CI gates.
recovery: Revert this single logical commit if completion cancellation/error mapping regresses.
